results.title: 中国2026年10月19日公布对盾构机等实施出口管制，11月18日生效。
results.description:
中国2026年10月19日公布对盾构机等实施出口管制，11月18日生效。敏感争议地区需许可，其他地区登记并承诺不转售即可。

对印度影响较大：地铁、高铁及边境隧道项目依赖进口设备，可能面临供应延迟或成本上升。印方内部正与业界商讨，加速推进国产化激励计划，暂无正式官方抗议声明。

对越南：河内地铁项目需求大，但非敏感地区，合规出口仍可进行。目前未见越南官方回应。

results.title: The difference is the two dashes the PRC removed from the 1947 ROC 11-dash line in the early 1950s.
results.description:
The difference is the two dashes the PRC removed from the 1947 ROC 11-dash line in the early 1950s. Those segments were in the Gulf of Tonkin. 

That area is now delimited by the 2000 China-Vietnam maritime boundary agreement (in force 2004). Control is split roughly 47% China / 53% Vietnam under the treaty; neither side claims exclusive control of the whole difference, and Taiwan has no presence there.
